title: End Times and Eschatology Doctrine
content: The Bible teaches that Jesus Christ will return visibly and bodily at the end of the age. His return will bring the resurrection of the dead and the final judgment of all humanity. Scripture teaches that evil will ultimately be defeated and God will establish eternal righteousness. Those who trust in Christ will receive eternal life, while those who reject Him will face judgment. God will create a new heaven and a new earth where righteousness dwells and where God will live with His people forever.
